info.name: SRD 5.1: Spells
info.author: DaybreakBuilder contributors (SRD 5.1 content by Wizards of the Coast, CC-BY-4.0)

description.p: You hurl a bubble of acid at one creature, or two creatures within 5 feet of each other. A target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 acid damage. The damage increases by 1d6 at 5th, 11th and 17th level.

A ghostly hand clings to a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit the target takes 1d8 necrotic damage and can’t regain hit points until the start of your next turn. An undead target also has disadvantage on attacks against you. The damage increases by 1d8 at 5th, 11th and 17th level.

You create up to four torch-sized lights that shed dim light in a 10-foot radius, or combine them into one glowing Medium form. As a bonus action you can move the lights up to 60 feet; each must stay within 20 feet of another.

setters.set: a bit of phosphorus or wychwood, or a glowworm

description.p: You create a tiny, harmless sensory effect that predicts the weather, makes a flower bloom, produces a minor sensory effect, or lights or snuffs out a small flame.

A beam of crackling energy streaks toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit the target takes 1d10 force damage. You create additional beams at higher levels: two at 5th, three at 11th and four at 17th level, each with its own attack roll.

You hurl a mote of fire at a creature or object. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit the target takes 1d10 fire damage, and flammable objects that aren’t worn or carried ignite. The damage increases by 1d10 at 5th, 11th and 17th level.
You touch one willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add it to one ability check of its choice.

You touch one object no larger than 10 feet in any dimension. It sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet. Covering it with something opaque blocks the light. An unwilling creature holding the object can make a Dexterity save to avoid it.

A spectral, floating hand appears. You can use your action to control it to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, or retrieve an item. It can’t attack, activate magic items or carry more than 10 pounds.
This spell repairs a single break or tear in an object you touch, such as a broken chain link or a torn cloak, as long as it is no larger than 1 foot in any dimension.
You point toward a creature within range and whisper a message. The target (and only the target) hears it and can reply in a whisper that only you can hear.

setters.set: a short piece of copper wire

description.p: You create a sound or an image of an object (no larger than a 5-foot cube) that lasts for the duration. A creature that uses its action to examine it can determine it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC.
You project a puff of noxious gas from your palm. The creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 1d12 poison damage. The damage increases by 1d12 at 5th, 11th and 17th level.

A minor magical trick: create a harmless sensory effect, light or snuff a small flame, clean or soil an object, chill, warm or flavor food, make a small mark or symbol appear, or create a trinket or illusory image that fits in your hand.

A flickering flame appears in your hand, shedding bright light in a 10-foot radius. You can hurl it at a creature within 30 feet as a ranged spell attack, dealing 1d8 fire damage. The damage increases by 1d8 at 5th, 11th and 17th level.

A frigid beam streaks toward a creature. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit it takes 1d8 cold damage and its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. The damage increases by 1d8 at 5th, 11th and 17th level.
You touch one willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add it to one saving throw of its choice.

Flame-like radiance descends on a creature you can see. It must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d8 radiant damage; it gains no benefit from cover. The damage increases by 1d8 at 5th, 11th and 17th level.

The wood of a club or quarterstaff you are holding is imbued with nature’s power. For the duration you can use your spellcasting ability instead of Strength for its attack and damage rolls, its damage die becomes a d8, and it counts as magical.

setters.set: mistletoe, a shamrock leaf and a club or quarterstaff

description.p: Lightning springs from your hand. Make a melee spell attack, with advantage if the target wears metal armor. On a hit it takes 1d8 lightning damage and can’t take reactions until its next turn. The damage increases by 1d8 at 5th, 11th and 17th level.
You touch a living creature that has 0 hit points. The creature becomes stable. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.
You manifest a minor wonder: your voice booms, flames flicker, tremors shake the ground, an instantaneous sound rings out, a door or window flies open or slams shut, or your eyes change appearance.
You point a finger at a target and gain brief insight into its defenses. On your next turn, you gain advantage on your first attack roll against the target, provided this spell hasn’t ended.

You unleash a string of insults laced with subtle enchantments. A creature that can hear you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take 1d4 psychic damage and have disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn. The damage increases by 1d4 at 5th, 11th and 17th level.

You set an alarm against unwanted intrusion on a door, window or area no larger than a 20-foot cube. Until the spell ends, an alarm alerts you whenever a Tiny or larger creature touches or enters the warded area. You choose an audible or mental alarm.

setters.set: a tiny bell and a piece of fine silver wire

description.p: You convince a beast that you mean it no harm. A beast with Intelligence 3 or lower must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for the duration. You can affect one additional beast per slot level above 1st.

Up to three creatures must make Charisma saving throws. Whenever a target that fails makes an attack roll or saving throw before the spell ends, it must subtract a d4 from the roll. You can target one additional creature per slot level above 1st.

You bless up to three creatures. Whenever a target makes an attack roll or saving throw before the spell ends, it can roll a d4 and add the number rolled. You can target one additional creature per slot level above 1st.

A thin sheet of flames shoots from your fingertips. Each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6 fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success. Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 1st.

You attempt to charm a humanoid. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (with advantage if you or your companions are fighting it) or be charmed by you until the spell ends or you or your companions harm it. It knows it was charmed when the spell ends. One additional target per slot level above 1st.

Roll 6d10; this is how many hit points of creatures the spell can affect. Starting with the lowest hit points, creatures in a 15-foot cone are blinded until the end of your next turn. Roll an additional 2d10 per slot level above 1st.

You speak a one-word command to a creature that understands your language. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or follow the command (such as approach, drop, flee, grovel or halt) on its next turn. One additional creature per slot level above 1st.
For the duration, you understand the literal meaning of any spoken language that you hear and any written language you touch (about 1 minute per page). It doesn’t decode secret messages.

setters.set: a pinch of soot and salt

description.p: You create up to 10 gallons of clean water in an open container or as rain in a 30-foot cube, or destroy up to 10 gallons of water or fog in a 30-foot cube. You create or destroy 10 additional gallons (and 5 more feet of cube) per slot level above 1st.

setters.set: a drop of water or a few grains of sand

description.p: A creature you touch regains hit points equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. No effect on undead or constructs. Healing increases by 1d8 per slot level above 1st.

For the duration, you know if there is an aberration, celestial, elemental, fey, fiend or undead within 30 feet of you, as well as where it is located, and you can sense consecrated or desecrated places and objects. Most barriers block it.

element.name: Detect Magic
element.supports: Bard, Cleric, Druid, Paladin, Ranger, Sorcerer, Wizard

description.p: For the duration, you sense the presence of magic within 30 feet. You can use your action to see a faint aura around any visible magical creature or object in the area and learn its school of magic, if any.
For the duration, you can sense the presence and location of poisons, poisonous creatures and diseases within 30 feet of you, and identify the kind of poison, creature or disease.

You make yourself, including your clothing and belongings, look different until the spell ends. You can seem 1 foot shorter or taller and appear thin, fat or in between. A creature can use its action to inspect you with an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC.
Your prayer empowers you with divine radiance. Until the spell ends, your weapon attacks deal an extra 1d4 radiant damage on a hit.

Grasping weeds and vines sprout in a 20-foot square, making it difficult terrain. A creature in the area when you cast it must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be restrained; it can use its action to make a Strength check to free itself.
This spell allows you to move at an incredible pace. When you cast it, and then as a bonus action on each of your turns until it ends, you can take the Dash action.

Each object and creature in a 20-foot cube is outlined in blue, green or violet light (your choice) if it fails a Dexterity saving throw. Attack rolls against an affected creature or object have advantage, and it can’t benefit from being invisible.
Bolstering yourself with a necromantic facsimile of life, you gain 1d4 + 4 temporary hit points for the duration. You gain 5 additional temporary hit points per slot level above 1st.

setters.set: a small amount of alcohol or distilled spirits

description.p: Choose up to five falling creatures within range. A falling creature’s rate of descent slows to 60 feet per round until the spell ends. If it lands before the spell ends, it takes no falling damage.

setters.set: 1 reaction, when you or a creature within 60 feet falls
a small feather or piece of down

description.p: You gain the service of a familiar, a spirit that takes an animal form you choose (such as a bat, cat, hawk, owl, rat or toad). It acts independently but obeys your commands, can deliver your touch spells, and you can see through its senses as an action.

setters.set: 10 gp worth of charcoal, incense and herbs that the fire consumes

description.p: This spell creates a circular, horizontal plane of force, 3 feet in diameter, that floats 3 feet above the ground and can hold up to 500 pounds. It follows you, staying within 20 feet.

You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of fog centered on a point within range. The area is heavily obscured. A wind of at least 10 miles per hour disperses it. The radius increases by 20 feet per slot level above 1st.

Up to ten berries appear in your hand, infused with magic for 24 hours. A creature can use its action to eat one berry, restoring 1 hit point and providing enough nourishment to sustain it for one day.

Slick grease covers a 10-foot square, making it difficult terrain. Each creature standing in it when it appears, or entering or ending its turn there, must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

setters.set: a bit of pork rind or butter

description.p: A flash of light streaks toward a creature. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit the target takes 4d6 radiant damage, and the next attack roll made against it before the end of your next turn has advantage. Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 1st.
A creature of your choice that you can see regains hit points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier. No effect on undead or constructs. Healing increases by 1d4 per slot level above 1st.

The creature that damaged you is momentarily surrounded by hellish flames. It must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d10 fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success. Damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 1st.

setters.set: 1 reaction, when a creature within 60 feet damages you

description.p: A willing creature you touch is imbued with bravery. Until the spell ends, it is immune to being frightened and gains temporary hit points equal to your spellcasting ability modifier at the start of each of its turns. One additional creature per slot level above 1st.

A creature of your choice must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or fall prone, becoming incapacitated and unable to stand up as it laughs uncontrollably. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns and when it takes damage. Creatures with Intelligence 4 or lower are unaffected.

You mark a creature as your quarry. Until the spell ends, you deal an extra 1d6 damage whenever you hit it with a weapon attack, and you have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) and (Survival) checks to find it. If it drops to 0 hit points, you can move the mark as a bonus action.

You choose one object that you must touch throughout the casting. If it is a magic item, you learn its properties, how to use them, whether it requires attunement and how many charges it has. You also learn whether any spells are affecting it.

setters.set: a pearl worth at least 100 gp and an owl feather

description.p: You write on parchment or paper and imbue it with an illusion. To you and creatures you designate, the writing appears normal; to others it appears as unintelligible script or a different message.

setters.set: a lead-based ink worth at least 10 gp, which the spell consumes

description.p: Make a melee spell attack against a creature you can reach. On a hit, the target takes 3d10 necrotic damage. Damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 1st.
You touch a creature. The creature’s jump distance is tripled until the spell ends.
You touch a creature. The target’s speed increases by 10 feet until the spell ends. One additional creature per slot level above 1st.
You touch a willing creature who isn’t wearing armor. Until the spell ends, the target’s base AC becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier. The spell ends if the target dons armor or you dismiss it.

You create three glowing darts of magical force. Each dart hits a creature of your choice that you can see and deals 1d4 + 1 force damage. The darts strike simultaneously. One additional dart per slot level above 1st.

Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is protected against aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends and undead: they have disadvantage on attacks against it, and it can’t be charmed, frightened or possessed by them.

setters.set: holy water or powdered silver and iron, which the spell consumes

description.p: All nonmagical food and drink within a 5-foot-radius sphere is purified and rendered free of poison and disease.

You ward a creature against attack. Until the spell ends, any creature who targets the warded creature with an attack or harmful spell must first make a Wisdom saving throw; on a failure it must choose a new target or lose the attack or spell. The spell ends if the warded creature attacks or casts a spell that affects an enemy.
An invisible barrier of magical force protects you. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from magic missile.

setters.set: 1 reaction, when you are hit by an attack or targeted by magic missile

description.p: A shimmering field surrounds a creature of your choice, granting it a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

setters.set: a small parchment with a bit of holy text

description.p: You create the image of an object, creature or other visible phenomenon no larger than a 15-foot cube. It is purely visual. You can use your action to move it. A creature can use its action to examine it with an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC.

Roll 5d8; this is how many hit points of creatures the spell can affect. Creatures within 20 feet of a point you choose fall unconscious in ascending order of current hit points, until the spell ends or they take damage. Undead and creatures immune to being charmed aren’t affected. Roll an additional 2d8 per slot level above 1st.

setters.set: a pinch of fine sand, rose petals or a cricket

description.p: You gain the ability to comprehend and verbally communicate with beasts for the duration. Their knowledge and awareness are limited by their intelligence.

A wave of thunderous force sweeps out from you. Each creature in a 15-foot cube must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 2d8 thunder damage and is pushed 10 feet away; on a success it takes half damage and isn’t pushed. Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 1st.

This spell creates an invisible, mindless, shapeless force that performs simple tasks at your command, such as fetching things, cleaning, mending, folding clothes or serving drinks. As a bonus action you can mentally command it to move up to 15 feet and interact with an object.

setters.set: a piece of string and a bit of wood

description.p: A shimmering green arrow streaks toward a target. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit it takes 4d4 acid damage immediately and 2d4 at the end of its next turn. On a miss it takes half the initial damage only. Damage (both) increases by 1d4 per slot level above 2nd.

setters.set: powdered rhubarb leaf and an adder’s stomach

description.p: Your spell bolsters your allies. Choose up to three creatures; each one’s hit point maximum and current hit points increase by 5 for the duration. The increase is 5 more per slot level above 2nd.

setters.set: a tiny strip of white cloth

description.p: You assume a different form: adapt to water (gills and webbed limbs, swimming speed equal to walking speed), change your appearance, or grow natural weapons (claws, fangs, horns) that deal 1d6 damage and count as magical with a +1 bonus.

A Tiny beast of your choice travels to a location you describe to deliver a message of up to 25 words to a creature you describe. It travels up to 50 miles per 24 hours (25 if it can’t fly). The duration increases by 48 hours per slot level above 2nd.

You touch a closed door, window, gate, chest or other entryway, and it becomes locked for the duration. You and creatures you designate can open it normally. Otherwise it is impassable until broken or the spell is dispelled; the DC to break or pick it increases by 10.

setters.set: gold dust worth at least 25 gp, which the spell consumes

description.p: You place an illusion on a creature or object you touch so that divination spells reveal false information about it: a false aura (making it appear magical or nonmagical, or of another school) or a mask (making it appear to be a different creature type).
By casting gem-inlaid sticks or similar tokens, you receive an omen about the results of a specific course of action you plan to take within the next 30 minutes: weal, woe, weal and woe, or nothing.

setters.set: specially marked sticks, bones or similar tokens worth at least 25 gp

description.p: You touch a willing creature. Until the spell ends, the target’s skin has a rough, bark-like appearance, and its AC can’t be less than 16, regardless of what kind of armor it is wearing.

You can blind or deafen a foe. Choose one creature that you can see; it must make a Constitution saving throw or be blinded or deafened (your choice). It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. One additional creature per slot level above 2nd.
Your body becomes blurred, shifting and wavering. For the duration, any creature has disadvantage on attack rolls against you, unless it doesn’t rely on sight or can see through illusions.

Each humanoid in a 20-foot-radius sphere must make a Charisma saving throw (willing creatures can fail). On a failure, you choose to suppress any effect causing it to be charmed or frightened, or make it indifferent about creatures it is hostile toward.
A flame, equivalent in brightness to a torch, springs forth from an object that you touch. It looks like a regular flame but creates no heat and doesn’t use oxygen.

setters.set: ruby dust worth 50 gp, which the spell consumes

description.p: Magical darkness spreads from a point you choose to fill a 15-foot-radius sphere. A creature with darkvision can’t see through it, and nonmagical light can’t illuminate it. If cast on an object, covering the object blocks the darkness.

setters.set: bat fur and a drop of pitch or piece of coal

description.p: You touch a willing creature to grant it the ability to see in the dark. For the duration, that creature has darkvision out to a range of 60 feet.

setters.set: a pinch of dried carrot or an agate

description.p: For the duration, you can read the surface thoughts of a creature within 30 feet. You can use your action to probe deeper (Wisdom save to resist) or shift your focus to another creature. You can also detect the presence of thinking creatures you can’t see.

You touch a creature and bestow upon it a magical enhancement: advantage on checks with one ability, plus a minor extra benefit (such as 2d6 temporary hit points for Bear’s Endurance or no falling damage from 20 feet for Cat’s Grace). One additional creature per slot level above 2nd.

setters.set: fur or a feather from a beast

description.p: You cause a creature or object to grow or shrink for the duration (Constitution save if unwilling). Enlarged: size doubles, advantage on Strength checks and saves, weapons deal an extra 1d4 damage. Reduced: size halves, disadvantage on Strength checks and saves, weapons deal 1d4 less damage.

You weave a distracting string of words. Creatures that can hear you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made to perceive any creature other than you until the spell ends.

You summon a spirit that assumes the form of an unusually intelligent, strong and loyal steed (warhorse, pony, camel, elk or mastiff). It serves as your mount, and you can communicate telepathically with it within 1 mile. When you cast a spell targeting only yourself, you can have it also target the steed.
You sense the presence of any trap within range that is within line of sight. You learn the general nature of the danger posed by a trap you sense, but not its location.

You evoke a fiery blade in your free hand. You can use your action to make a melee spell attack with it, dealing 3d6 fire damage on a hit. It sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius. Damage increases by 1d6 for every two slot levels above 2nd.

A 5-foot-diameter sphere of fire appears. Any creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of it must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d6 fire damage on a failure or half on a success. As a bonus action you can move the sphere up to 30 feet, ramming creatures it hits. Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 2nd.

setters.set: a bit of tallow, a pinch of brimstone and a dusting of powdered iron

description.p: You touch a corpse or other remains. For the duration, the target is protected from decay and can’t become undead. The spell also extends the time limit on raising the target from the dead.

setters.set: a pinch of salt and one copper piece placed on each of the corpse’s eyes

description.p: A line of strong wind 60 feet long and 10 feet wide blasts from you. Each creature that starts its turn in the line must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed 15 feet away. Moving toward you costs double. The gust disperses gas and extinguishes unprotected flames.

Choose a manufactured metal object that you can see. You cause it to glow red-hot. Any creature in physical contact with it takes 2d8 fire damage when you cast the spell and again as a bonus action on later turns; if it holds or wears the object it must succeed on a Constitution save or drop it, or have disadvantage on attacks and checks. Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 2nd.

setters.set: a piece of iron and a flame

element.name: Hold Person
element.supports: Bard, Cleric, Druid, Sorcerer, Warlock, Wizard

description.p: Choose a humanoid that you can see. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be paralyzed for the duration, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns. One additional humanoid per slot level above 2nd.

setters.set: a small, straight piece of iron

description.p: A creature you touch becomes invisible until the spell ends. Anything the target is wearing or carrying is invisible as long as it is on the target’s person. The spell ends if the target attacks or casts a spell. One additional creature per slot level above 2nd.

setters.set: an eyelash encased in gum arabic

description.p: Choose an object that you can see that contains a mundane or magical means that prevents access, such as a locked door or chest. A lock or stuck item opens and one arcane lock is suppressed for 10 minutes. The spell creates a loud knock audible from 300 feet away.
You touch a creature and can end either one disease or one condition afflicting it. The condition can be blinded, deafened, paralyzed or poisoned.

One creature or loose object of your choice (up to 500 pounds) rises vertically up to 20 feet and remains suspended there. An unwilling creature can make a Constitution save. The target can move only by pushing or pulling against fixed objects; you can change its altitude by up to 20 feet each turn.

setters.set: a small leather loop or a piece of golden wire bent into a cup shape

description.p: Describe or name a specific kind of beast or plant. Concentrating on the voice of nature, you learn the direction and distance to the closest creature or plant of that kind within 5 miles, if any are present.

setters.set: a bit of fur from a bloodhound

element.name: Locate Object
element.supports: Bard, Cleric, Druid, Paladin, Ranger, Wizard

description.p: Describe or name an object that is familiar to you. You sense the direction to the object’s location, as long as it is within 1,000 feet of you. A thin sheet of lead blocks the spell.
You implant a message of up to 25 words within an object. When a trigger condition you choose occurs, a magical mouth appears on the object and recites the message.

setters.set: a small bit of honeycomb and jade dust worth at least 10 gp, which the spell consumes

description.p: You touch a nonmagical weapon. Until the spell ends, it becomes a magic weapon with a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls. The bonus becomes +2 with a 4th-level slot and +3 with a 6th-level slot or higher.

Three illusory duplicates of yourself appear in your space. Each time a creature targets you with an attack, roll a d20 to determine whether it targets a duplicate instead (6+ with three duplicates, 8+ with two, 11+ with one). A duplicate has AC 10 + your Dexterity modifier and is destroyed when hit.
Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see.

A silvery beam of pale light shines down in a 5-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder. When a creature enters it for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 2d10 radiant damage on a failure or half on a success. Shapechangers have disadvantage. You can move the beam 60 feet as an action. Damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 2nd.

setters.set: several seeds of any moonseed plant and a piece of opalescent feldspar

description.p: A veil of shadows and silence radiates from you. For the duration, each creature you choose within 30 feet of you has a +10 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks and can’t be tracked except by magical means.

setters.set: ashes from a burned leaf of mistletoe and a sprig of spruce

description.p: Up to six creatures of your choice that you can see each regain hit points equal to 2d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. No effect on undead or constructs. Healing increases by 1d8 per slot level above 2nd.
You touch a creature. If it is poisoned, you neutralize the poison. For the duration, the target has advantage on saving throws against being poisoned, and resistance to poison damage.

A black beam of enervating energy springs from your finger. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit the target deals only half damage with weapon attacks that use Strength until the spell ends. It makes a Constitution save at the end of each of its turns to end the spell.

You touch a length of rope up to 60 feet long. One end rises until the whole rope hangs perpendicular to the ground, and an invisible entrance at its top opens into an extradimensional space that can hold up to eight Medium or smaller creatures.

setters.set: powdered corn extract and a twisted loop of parchment

description.p: You create three rays of fire and hurl them at targets within range. Make a ranged spell attack for each ray; on a hit the target takes 2d6 fire damage. One additional ray per slot level above 2nd.
For the duration, you see invisible creatures and objects as if they were visible, and you can see into the Ethereal Plane.

setters.set: a pinch of talc and a small sprinkling of powdered silver

description.p: A sudden loud ringing noise erupts from a point you choose. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius sphere must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 3d8 thunder damage on a failure or half on a success (disadvantage for creatures made of inorganic material). Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 2nd.

For the duration, no sound can be created within or pass through a 20-foot-radius sphere. Any creature or object entirely inside is immune to thunder damage, and creatures are deafened while entirely inside it. Casting a spell with a verbal component there is impossible.

Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch gains the ability to move up, down and across vertical surfaces and upside down along ceilings, while leaving its hands free. It also gains a climbing speed equal to its walking speed.

setters.set: a drop of bitumen and a spider

description.p: The ground in a 20-foot-radius area twists and sprouts hard spikes and thorns. It becomes difficult terrain, and a creature takes 2d4 piercing damage for every 5 feet it travels through it. The area is camouflaged to look natural.

setters.set: seven sharp thorns or seven small twigs

description.p: You create a floating, spectral weapon. When you cast it, you can make a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of the weapon, dealing 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier force damage. As a bonus action on later turns, you can move it 20 feet and attack again. Damage increases by 1d8 for every two slot levels above 2nd.

You suggest a course of activity (limited to a sentence or two) to a creature you can see within range that can hear and understand you. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or pursue the course of action as best it can. The suggestion must sound reasonable.

setters.set: a snake’s tongue and either a bit of honeycomb or a drop of sweet oil

description.p: This spell wards a willing creature you touch and creates a mystic connection between you. While it is within 60 feet of you, it gains a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws and resistance to all damage, and each time it takes damage you take the same amount.

setters.set: a pair of platinum rings worth at least 50 gp each

description.p: You conjure a 20-foot cube of thick, sticky webbing. It is difficult terrain and lightly obscures the area. A creature starting its turn in or entering the webs must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be restrained; it can use its action to make a Strength check to escape. The webs are flammable.

You create a magical zone that guards against deception in a 15-foot-radius sphere. A creature that enters it or starts its turn there must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be unable to speak a deliberate lie while in the radius. You know whether each creature succeeds.

This spell creates an undead servant. Choose a pile of bones or a corpse of a Medium or Small humanoid; it becomes a skeleton or zombie under your control for 24 hours, obeying your mental commands. Recasting reasserts control over up to four creatures. You animate or reassert control over two additional undead per slot level above 3rd.

setters.set: a drop of blood, a piece of flesh and a pinch of bone dust

description.p: This spell bestows hope and vitality. Any number of creatures within range have advantage on Wisdom saving throws and death saving throws, and regain the maximum number of hit points possible from any healing.

You touch a creature, which must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become cursed: disadvantage on checks and saves with one ability, disadvantage on attacks against you, a chance to waste its turn, or extra 1d8 necrotic damage from your attacks. Higher slots extend the duration (8 hours at 5th, 24 hours at 7th, until dispelled at 9th) without concentration.

Roll a d20 at the end of each of your turns for the duration. On 11 or higher, you vanish to the Ethereal Plane until the start of your next turn, then return to an unoccupied space within 10 feet of where you vanished.

A storm cloud appears 100 feet overhead. When you cast the spell, and as an action on later turns, you call down a bolt of lightning on a point below the cloud: each creature within 5 feet must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d10 lightning damage on a failure or half on a success. Damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 3rd.
You create an invisible sensor within range in a location familiar to you or in an obvious location that is unfamiliar. You can see or hear (your choice) through the sensor as if you were there.

setters.set: a focus worth at least 100 gp, either a jeweled horn for hearing or a glass eye for seeing

description.p: You summon fey spirits that take the form of beasts: one beast of CR 2 or lower, two of CR 1, four of CR 1/2 or eight of CR 1/4. They are friendly to you, obey your verbal commands and act on their own initiative. Higher slots summon more creatures (twice as many at 5th, three times at 7th, four times at 9th).

You attempt to interrupt a creature in the process of casting a spell. If it is casting a spell of 3rd level or lower, its spell fails. If higher, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability (DC 10 + the spell’s level); on a success the spell fails. A higher slot automatically counters spells of that level or lower.

setters.set: 1 reaction, when you see a creature within 60 feet casting a spell

description.p: You create 45 pounds of food and 30 gallons of water on the ground or in containers within range, enough to sustain up to fifteen humanoids or five steeds for 24 hours. The food spoils after 24 hours.

A 60-foot-radius sphere of light spreads out from a point you choose, shedding bright light and dim light for an additional 60 feet. It dispels magical darkness of 3rd level or lower in its area. If cast on an object, covering the object blocks the light.

element.name: Dispel Magic
element.supports: Bard, Cleric, Druid, Paladin, Sorcerer, Warlock, Wizard

description.p: Choose one creature, object or magical effect within range. Any spell of 3rd level or lower on the target ends. For each higher-level spell, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability (DC 10 + the spell’s level). A higher slot automatically ends spells of that level or lower.

Each creature in a 30-foot cone must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or drop whatever it is holding and become frightened. While frightened, it must Dash away from you by the safest route; it repeats the save at the end of each turn it can’t see you.

setters.set: a white feather or the heart of a hen

description.p: A bright streak flashes to a point you choose and blossoms into an explosion of flame. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d6 fire damage on a failure or half on a success. The fire spreads around corners and ignites unattended flammable objects. Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 3rd.

setters.set: a tiny ball of bat guano and sulfur

description.p: You touch a willing creature. The target gains a flying speed of 60 feet for the duration. When the spell ends, the target falls if it is still aloft. One additional creature per slot level above 3rd.

setters.set: a wing feather from any bird

description.p: You transform a willing creature into a misty cloud. Its only method of movement is a flying speed of 10 feet; it has resistance to nonmagical damage and advantage on Strength, Dexterity and Constitution saves, can pass through small holes, but can’t talk, attack or cast spells.

setters.set: a bit of gauze and a wisp of smoke

description.p: You inscribe a glyph on a surface or within a closed object. When triggered, it either erupts with magical energy (5d8 damage of a type you choose in a 20-foot sphere, Dexterity save for half) or casts a stored spell of 3rd level or lower. Damage or stored spell level increases with higher slots.

setters.set: incense and powdered diamond worth at least 200 gp, which the spell consumes

description.p: Choose a willing creature. Until the spell ends, its speed is doubled, it gains a +2 bonus to AC, it has advantage on Dexterity saving throws, and it gains an additional action on each of its turns (Attack with one weapon attack only, Dash, Disengage, Hide or Use an Object). When the spell ends, it can’t move or take actions until after its next turn.

You create a twisting pattern of colors in a 30-foot cube. Each creature that sees it must make a Wisdom saving throw or become charmed: incapacitated with a speed of 0. The effect ends for a creature if it takes damage or someone uses an action to shake it out of its stupor.

setters.set: a glowing stick of incense or a crystal vial filled with phosphorescent material

description.p: A stroke of lightning forming a line 100 feet long and 5 feet wide blasts out from you. Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d6 lightning damage on a failure or half on a success. Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 3rd.

setters.set: a bit of fur and a rod of amber, crystal or glass

description.p: You create a 10-foot-radius, 20-foot-tall cylinder of magical energy against one or more of celestials, elementals, fey, fiends or undead. Such creatures can’t willingly enter it by nonmagical means, have disadvantage on attacks against targets within it, and can’t charm, frighten or possess targets within it. It can be reversed to trap a creature inside. Duration increases by 1 hour per slot level above 3rd.

setters.set: holy water or powdered silver and iron worth at least 100 gp, which the spell consumes

description.p: You create the image of an object, creature or phenomenon no larger than a 20-foot cube, complete with sounds, smells and temperature. You can use your action to make it move or change. A creature can examine it with an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC. At 6th level or higher it lasts until dispelled without concentration.

As you call out words of restoration, up to six creatures of your choice that you can see regain hit points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier. Healing increases by 1d4 per slot level above 3rd.

You step into a stone object or surface large enough to fully contain your body, melding yourself and your equipment with it for the duration. You can’t see outside, and only spells that target you can affect you. Partial destruction of the stone expels you and deals damage.

For the duration, you hide a target that you touch from divination magic. The target can be a willing creature or a place or object no larger than 10 feet in any dimension. It can’t be targeted by divination magic or perceived through magical scrying sensors.

setters.set: a pinch of diamond dust worth 25 gp sprinkled over the target, which the spell consumes

description.p: A Large quasi-real, horselike creature appears on the ground. You decide its appearance; it is equipped with a saddle, bit and bridle. It has a speed of 100 feet and can travel 10 miles in an hour. It disappears if it takes damage.

With a 1-action casting, plants in a 100-foot radius become thick and overgrown: a creature must spend 4 feet of movement for every 1 foot it moves. With an 8-hour casting, plants within half a mile are enriched for a year, yielding twice the normal amount of food when harvested.
For the duration, the willing creature you touch has resistance to one damage type of your choice: acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder.
At your touch, all curses affecting one creature or object end. If the object is a cursed magic item, its curse remains, but the spell breaks its owner’s attunement so it can be removed or discarded.

You touch a creature that has died within the last minute. That creature returns to life with 1 hit point. This spell can’t return to life a creature that has died of old age, nor can it restore any missing body parts.

setters.set: diamonds worth 300 gp, which the spell consumes

description.p: You send a short message of twenty-five words or less to a creature with which you are familiar. It hears the message in its mind, recognizes you if it knows you, and can answer in a like manner immediately. The message can travel across planes, with a 5 percent chance of failing to arrive.

setters.set: a short piece of fine copper wire

description.p: Freezing rain and sleet fall in a 20-foot-tall, 40-foot-radius cylinder. The area is heavily obscured, difficult terrain and exposed flames are doused. A creature entering or starting its turn there must succeed on a Dexterity save or fall prone, and a concentrating creature must make a Constitution save or lose concentration.

setters.set: a pinch of dust and a few drops of water

description.p: You alter time around up to six creatures of your choice in a 40-foot cube. Each target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have its speed halved, take a −2 penalty to AC and Dexterity saves, be unable to take reactions, and take either an action or a bonus action (not both) each turn, with spellcasting possibly delayed. It repeats the save at the end of each turn.

You grant the semblance of life and intelligence to a corpse of your choice that has a mouth and isn’t undead. Until the spell ends, you can ask it up to five questions. It knows only what it knew in life, and its answers are usually brief or cryptic.

You imbue plants within 30 feet of you with limited sentience and animation, giving them the ability to communicate with you and follow simple commands. You can question them about events in the area and have them make difficult terrain normal or vice versa.

You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of yellow, nauseating gas. The area is heavily obscured. Each creature that starts its turn in it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against poison or spend its action that turn retching and reeling.

setters.set: a rotten egg or several skunk cabbage leaves

description.p: This spell grants the creature you touch the ability to understand any spoken language it hears. Moreover, when the target speaks, any creature that knows at least one language and can hear it understands what it says.

setters.set: a small clay model of a ziggurat

description.p: The touch of your shadow-wreathed hand can siphon life force from others. Make a melee spell attack against a creature within reach; on a hit it takes 3d6 necrotic damage, and you regain hit points equal to half the damage dealt. You can attack again as an action on each of your turns. Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 3rd.
This spell grants up to ten willing creatures you can see within range the ability to breathe underwater until the spell ends. Affected creatures also retain their normal mode of respiration.

setters.set: a short reed or piece of straw

description.p: This spell grants the ability to move across any liquid surface, such as water, acid, mud, snow, quicksand or lava, as if it were harmless solid ground, to up to ten willing creatures you can see within range.

A wall of strong wind, up to 50 feet long, 15 feet high and 1 foot thick, rises from the ground. When it appears, each creature in its area makes a Strength saving throw, taking 3d8 bludgeoning damage on a failure or half on a success. The wind keeps fog and gases at bay and deflects small creatures and normal ranged weapon ammunition.

setters.set: a tiny fan and a feather of exotic origin

description.p: You create an invisible, magical eye that hovers in the air for the duration. You mentally receive visual information from it, with darkvision out to 30 feet, and can move it up to 30 feet as an action. It can’t pass through solid barriers but can pass through openings as small as 1 inch.

You attempt to send one creature you can see to another plane. It must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be banished: a native creature goes to a harmless demiplane, an extraplanar one returns home permanently if the spell lasts its full duration. One additional creature per slot level above 4th.

setters.set: an item distasteful to the target

description.p: Squirming, ebony tentacles fill a 20-foot square, making it difficult terrain. A creature entering the area or starting its turn there must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 3d6 bludgeoning damage and be restrained. A restrained creature takes 3d6 damage at the start of each of its turns and can try to escape with a Strength or Dexterity check.

setters.set: a piece of tentacle from a giant octopus or squid

description.p: Necromantic energy washes over a creature, draining moisture and vitality from it. It must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 8d8 necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. Plant creatures have disadvantage and take maximum damage. Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 4th.

Creatures of your choice that can hear you must make a Wisdom saving throw or be affected. Until the spell ends, you can use a bonus action to designate a direction, and each affected target must use as much of its movement as possible to move in that direction on its next turn.

Each creature in a 10-foot-radius sphere must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be confused: it can’t take reactions and rolls a d10 each turn to determine whether it moves randomly, does nothing, attacks a nearby creature or acts normally. The radius increases by 5 feet per slot level above 4th.
You summon elementals: one of CR 2 or lower, two of CR 1, four of CR 1/2 or eight of CR 1/4. They are friendly to you and obey your verbal commands. Higher slots summon more creatures.
You summon fey creatures: one of CR 2 or lower, two of CR 1, four of CR 1/2 or eight of CR 1/4. They are friendly to you and obey your verbal commands. Higher slots summon more creatures.

setters.set: one holly berry per creature summoned

description.p: Until the spell ends, you control any freestanding water in a cube up to 100 feet on a side. You can flood the area, part the water, redirect its flow or create a whirlpool, changing the effect as an action.

setters.set: a drop of water and a pinch of dust

description.p: You touch a creature and grant it a measure of protection from death. The first time it would drop to 0 hit points as a result of taking damage, it instead drops to 1 hit point and the spell ends. It also negates one effect that would kill it instantaneously without dealing damage.

You teleport yourself from your current location to any other spot within range, which you can see, describe or specify by distance and direction. You can bring along one willing creature of your size or smaller that you are touching. If you would arrive in an occupied space, you each take 4d6 force damage and the spell fails.

Your magic and an offering put you in contact with a god or a god’s servants. You ask a single question concerning a specific goal, event or activity to occur within 7 days, and receive a truthful reply such as a short phrase, cryptic rhyme or omen.

setters.set: incense and a sacrificial offering worth at least 25 gp, which the spell consumes

description.p: You attempt to beguile a beast you can see. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (with advantage if you are fighting it) or be charmed. You have a telepathic link with it and can issue commands or take total control of it. Each time it takes damage it repeats the save. Higher slots extend the duration.

You convert raw materials into products of the same material: a wooden bridge from a clump of trees, a rope from a patch of hemp, or clothes from flax or wool. Objects can be up to a 10-foot cube (or 5-foot cube of mineral). Quality depends on the quality of the materials, and artisan items require proficiency with the relevant tools.

You conjure a phantom watchdog in an unoccupied space. It is invisible to all creatures except you and barks loudly when a Small or larger creature comes within 30 feet without speaking a password. At the start of each of your turns, it attempts to bite one hostile creature within 5 feet, dealing 4d8 piercing damage on a hit.

setters.set: a tiny silver whistle, a piece of bone and a thread

description.p: Thin and wispy flames wreathe your body, shedding light. Choose a warm shield (resistance to cold damage) or a chill shield (resistance to fire damage). Whenever a creature within 5 feet hits you with a melee attack, flames spring from the shield and it takes 2d8 fire or cold damage, respectively.

setters.set: a bit of phosphorus or a firefly

description.p: You touch a willing creature. For the duration, its movement is unaffected by difficult terrain, and spells and other magical effects can neither reduce its speed nor cause it to be paralyzed or restrained. It can also escape nonmagical restraints and grapples by spending 5 feet of movement, and moving underwater imposes no penalties.

setters.set: a leather strap, bound around the arm or a similar appendage

description.p: You transform up to ten centipedes, three spiders, five wasps or one scorpion within range into giant versions of their natural forms for the duration. Each creature obeys your verbal commands and acts on your turn.

You or a creature you touch becomes invisible until the spell ends. Anything the target is wearing or carrying is invisible as long as it is on the target’s person. Unlike invisibility, it doesn’t end when the target attacks or casts a spell.

A Large spectral guardian appears and hovers in an unoccupied space you can see. Any creature hostile to you that moves to a space within 10 feet of it for the first time on a turn must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 20 radiant damage (half on a success). The guardian vanishes after dealing a total of 60 damage.

You make natural terrain in a 150-foot cube look, sound and smell like some other sort of natural terrain. Manufactured structures, equipment and creatures within the area aren’t changed. A creature can use its action to discern the illusion with an Intelligence (Investigation) check.

setters.set: a stone, a twig and a bit of green plant

description.p: A hail of rock-hard ice pounds a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder. Each creature in it must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d8 bludgeoning and 4d6 cold damage on a failure or half on a success. The area becomes difficult terrain until the end of your next turn. Bludgeoning damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 4th.

setters.set: a pinch of dust and a few drops of water

element.name: Locate Creature
element.supports: Bard, Cleric, Druid, Paladin, Ranger, Wizard

description.p: Describe or name a creature that is familiar to you. You sense the direction to its location, as long as it is within 1,000 feet of you. If the creature is moving, you know the direction of its movement. Running water at least 10 feet wide blocks the spell.

setters.set: a bit of fur from a bloodhound

description.p: You tap into the nightmares of a creature you can see and create an illusory manifestation of its deepest fears, visible only to it. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become frightened. At the end of each of its turns, it must succeed on another Wisdom save or take 4d10 psychic damage. Damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 4th.

This spell transforms a creature you can see into a new beast form (Wisdom save if unwilling). The new form can be any beast whose challenge rating is equal to or less than the target’s (or its level). The target’s statistics are replaced, and it reverts when it drops to 0 hit points.

You make an area up to a 100-foot cube magically secure. You choose any of: sound can’t pass the barrier, the barrier appears dark and foggy, sensors from divination spells can’t appear inside, and creatures can’t teleport in or out or use planar travel to enter.

setters.set: a thin sheet of lead, a piece of opaque glass, a wad of cotton or cloth, and powdered chrysolite

description.p: A sphere of shimmering force encloses a creature or object of Large size or smaller (Dexterity save if unwilling). Nothing can pass through the barrier, which is immune to all damage, though a disintegrate spell destroys it. The enclosed creature can roll the sphere.

setters.set: a hemispherical piece of clear crystal and a matching hemisphere of gum arabic

description.p: You hide a chest, and all its contents, on the Ethereal Plane. While the chest remains there, you can use an action and touch the replica to recall the chest. After 60 days, there is a cumulative 5 percent chance per day that the spell’s effect ends.

setters.set: an exquisite chest worth at least 5,000 gp and a Tiny replica worth at least 50 gp

description.p: You touch a stone object of Medium size or smaller or a section of stone no more than 5 feet in any dimension and form it into any shape that suits your purpose, such as a weapon, idol, coffer, passage or simple door.
This spell turns the flesh of a willing creature you touch as hard as stone. Until the spell ends, the target has resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage.

setters.set: diamond dust worth 100 gp, which the spell consumes

description.p: You create a wall of fire up to 60 feet long, 20 feet high and 1 foot thick, or a ringed wall up to 20 feet in diameter. When it appears, each creature within it must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 5d8 fire damage on a failure or half on a success. One side of the wall deals 5d8 fire damage to creatures that end their turn within 10 feet or inside it. Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 4th.

Objects come to life at your command. Choose up to ten nonmagical objects within range that aren’t worn or carried (Medium counts as two, Large as four, Huge as eight). Each becomes a creature under your control; as a bonus action you can command any of them within 500 feet. Two additional objects per slot level above 5th.

A shimmering barrier extends out from you in a 10-foot radius and moves with you. It prevents creatures other than undead and constructs from passing or reaching through it. A creature can cast spells or make ranged attacks through it.

You create a Large hand of shimmering force. As a bonus action you can make it act: Clenched Fist (4d8 force damage), Forceful Hand (push a creature), Grasping Hand (grapple and crush for 2d6 + spellcasting modifier), or Interposing Hand (half cover). Damage increases with higher slots.

setters.set: an eggshell and a snakeskin glove

description.p: After spending the casting time tracing magical pathways within a precious gemstone, you touch a Huge or smaller beast or plant. It gains an Intelligence of 10 and the ability to speak one language you know, and is charmed by you for 30 days.

setters.set: an agate worth at least 1,000 gp, which the spell consumes

description.p: You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of poisonous, yellow-green fog. Each creature that enters it for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 5d8 poison damage on a failure or half on a success. The fog moves 10 feet away from you at the start of each of your turns. Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 5th.

You contact your deity or a divine proxy and ask up to three questions that can be answered with a yes or no. You receive a correct answer for each question, though the being may answer ‘unclear’. Casting it more than once before a long rest risks no answer.

setters.set: incense and a vial of holy or unholy water

description.p: You briefly become one with nature and gain knowledge of the surrounding territory: within 3 miles outdoors or 300 feet underground, you instantly gain knowledge of up to three facts such as terrain, plants, animals, powerful celestials, fey, fiends, elementals or undead, and influence from other planes.

A blast of cold air erupts from your hands. Each creature in a 60-foot cone must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 8d8 cold damage on a failure or half on a success. A creature killed by this spell becomes a frozen statue. Damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 5th.

setters.set: a small crystal or glass cone

description.p: You call forth an elemental servant of CR 5 or lower from a suitable mass of its element. It is friendly to you and obeys your verbal commands; if your concentration is broken, it becomes hostile. The CR increases by 1 per slot level above 5th.

setters.set: burning incense for air, soft clay for earth, sulfur and phosphorus for fire, or water and sand for water

description.p: You mentally contact a demigod, the spirit of a long-dead sage or some other mysterious entity from another plane. You must make a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw or take 6d6 psychic damage and be driven insane. On a success, you can ask up to five questions.

Your touch inflicts disease. Make a melee spell attack; on a hit you afflict the creature with a disease of your choice (blinding sickness, filth fever, flesh rot, mindfire, seizure or slimy doom). It makes Constitution saves at the end of its turns; three failures make the disease last for the full duration, three successes end it.

You pull wisps of shadow material from the Shadowfell to create a nonliving object of vegetable matter or mineral within range, no larger than a 5-foot cube. The duration depends on the material, from 1 day for vegetable matter to 1 minute for adamantine or mithral. The cube increases by 5 feet per slot level above 5th.

setters.set: a tiny piece of matter of the same type of the item you plan to create

description.p: Shimmering energy surrounds and protects you from fey, undead and creatures originating beyond the Material Plane: they have disadvantage on attacks against you. You can end the spell early to break an enchantment, or to banish such a creature you touch (Charisma save).

setters.set: holy water or powdered silver and iron

description.p: You attempt to beguile a humanoid you can see. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (with advantage if you are fighting it) or be charmed. You have a telepathic link with it, can issue commands and can take total control of it. It repeats the save each time it takes damage. Higher slots extend the duration.

This spell shapes a creature’s dreams. You or a willing creature becomes the messenger and enters the dreams of a target on the same plane. The messenger can converse with a sleeping target, or make the dream terrifying (Wisdom save or 3d6 psychic damage and no benefit from rest).

setters.set: a handful of sand, a dab of ink and a writing quill plucked from a sleeping bird

description.p: A vertical column of divine fire roars down from the heavens in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder. Each creature in it must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d6 fire damage and 4d6 radiant damage on a failure or half on a success. Fire or radiant damage (your choice) increases by 1d6 per slot level above 5th.

You place a magical command on a creature that you can see, forcing it to carry out some service or refrain from some action. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed for the duration, taking 5d10 psychic damage (no more than once a day) whenever it acts directly counter to your instructions. Higher slots extend the duration.

You imbue a creature you touch with positive energy to undo a debilitating effect. You can reduce its exhaustion level by one, or end one of: being charmed or petrified, one curse, any reduction to an ability score, or one effect reducing its hit point maximum.

setters.set: diamond dust worth at least 100 gp, which the spell consumes

description.p: You touch a point and infuse an area around it (up to 60-foot radius) with holy or unholy power. Celestials, elementals, fey, fiends and undead can’t enter it, can’t charm, frighten or possess creatures within it, and you can bind an extra effect such as courage, darkness, daylight, energy protection or silence.

setters.set: herbs, oils and incense worth at least 1,000 gp, which the spell consumes

description.p: Choose a creature that you can see. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be paralyzed for the duration, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns. This spell has no effect on undead. One additional creature per slot level above 5th.

setters.set: a small, straight piece of iron

description.p: Swarming, biting locusts fill a 20-foot-radius sphere, lightly obscuring it and making it difficult terrain. A creature entering it or starting its turn there must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 4d10 piercing damage on a failure or half on a success. Damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 5th.

setters.set: a few grains of sugar, some kernels of grain and a smear of fat

description.p: Name or describe a person, place or object. The spell brings to your mind a brief summary of the significant lore about it, if it is of legendary importance. The more information you already have, the more precise the result.

setters.set: incense worth at least 250 gp and four ivory strips worth at least 50 gp each

description.p: A wave of healing energy washes out from a point you choose. Up to six creatures in a 30-foot-radius sphere each regain hit points equal to 3d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. Healing increases by 1d8 per slot level above 5th.

You become invisible at the same time that an illusory double of you appears where you are standing. As an action, you can move the double up to twice your speed and make it gesture, speak and behave as you choose. You can see through its eyes and hear through its ears.

You attempt to reshape another creature’s memories. It must make a Wisdom saving throw (with advantage if you are fighting it) or become charmed, letting you eliminate, recall, change or create a memory of an event within the last 24 hours. Higher slots reach further into the past.
A passage appears at a point you choose on a wooden, plaster or stone surface (such as a wall, ceiling or floor) and lasts for the duration. It is up to 5 feet wide, 8 feet tall and 20 feet deep.

With this spell, you attempt to bind a celestial, elemental, fey or fiend to your service. The creature must be within range for the entire casting and must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or serve you for the duration. Higher slots increase the duration.

setters.set: a jewel worth at least 1,000 gp, which the spell consumes

description.p: You return a dead creature you touch to life, provided it has been dead no longer than 10 days and its soul is willing and free. It returns with 1 hit point and a −4 penalty to attack rolls, saving throws and ability checks that lessens each long rest.

setters.set: a diamond worth at least 500 gp, which the spell consumes

description.p: You touch a dead humanoid or a piece of one that has been dead no longer than 10 days. The spell forms a new adult body for it and calls its soul to enter that body; roll on a table to determine the new body’s race.

setters.set: rare oils and unguents worth at least 1,000 gp, which the spell consumes

description.p: You can see and hear a particular creature you choose that is on the same plane of existence as you. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw, modified by how well you know it and your connection to it; on a failure, an invisible sensor appears near it.

setters.set: a focus worth at least 1,000 gp, such as a crystal ball, silver mirror or font filled with holy water

description.p: This spell allows you to change the appearance of any number of creatures that you can see within range. An unwilling creature can make a Charisma save. Each target gets a new, illusory appearance until the spell ends.

You gain the ability to move or manipulate creatures or objects by thought. As an action each round, you can move a Huge or smaller creature (contested by its Strength) or an object weighing up to 1,000 pounds up to 30 feet, or exert fine control over an object.

You forge a telepathic link among up to eight willing creatures of your choice within range. Until the spell ends, the targets can communicate telepathically through the bond whether or not they share a language, at any distance on the same plane.

setters.set: pieces of eggshell from two different kinds of creatures

description.p: As you cast the spell, you draw a 10-foot-diameter circle on the ground inscribed with sigils that link your location to a permanent teleportation circle whose sigil sequence you know. A shimmering portal opens, and any creature that enters it appears at the destination circle.

setters.set: rare chalks and inks infused with precious gems worth 50 gp, which the spell consumes

description.p: You gain the ability to enter a tree and move from inside it to inside another tree of the same kind within 500 feet. Each transfer costs 5 feet of movement, and you can use this once per round for the duration.

An invisible wall of force springs into existence: a dome or sphere up to 10 feet in radius, or a flat surface made of up to ten 10-foot panels. Nothing can physically pass through the wall, which is immune to all damage and can’t be dispelled by dispel magic. A disintegrate spell destroys it instantly.

setters.set: a pinch of powder made by crushing a clear gemstone

description.p: A nonmagical wall of solid stone springs into existence, made of up to ten 10-foot-by-10-foot panels, 6 inches thick. If you maintain concentration for the full duration, the wall becomes permanent. Each panel has AC 15 and 30 hit points per inch of thickness.

You create a vertical wall of whirling, razor-sharp blades up to 100 feet long, 20 feet high and 5 feet thick, or a ring up to 60 feet in diameter. It provides three-quarters cover and is difficult terrain. A creature entering it or starting its turn there makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 6d10 slashing damage on a failure or half on a success.

A bolt of lightning arcs toward a target and then leaps to up to three other targets within 30 feet of the first. Each target makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 10d8 lightning damage on a failure or half on a success. One additional bolt leaps per slot level above 6th.

setters.set: a bit of fur, a piece of amber, glass or crystal rod, and three silver pins

description.p: A sphere of negative energy ripples out in a 60-foot radius from a point within range. Each creature in the area must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 8d6 necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. Damage increases by 2d6 per slot level above 6th.

setters.set: the powder of a crushed black pearl worth at least 500 gp

description.p: You summon a fey creature of CR 6 or lower, or a fey spirit in the form of a beast of CR 6 or lower. It is friendly to you and obeys your verbal commands; if your concentration is broken it becomes hostile. The CR increases by 1 per slot level above 6th.

Choose a spell of 5th level or lower that you can cast, that has a casting time of 1 action and that can target you. You cast that spell as part of casting contingency, and it takes effect when a circumstance you describe occurs.

setters.set: a statuette of yourself carved from ivory and decorated with gems worth at least 1,500 gp

description.p: You can cast this spell only at night. Choose up to three corpses of Medium or Small humanoids; each becomes a ghoul under your control for 24 hours. Higher slots create more or stronger undead (ghasts at 8th, wights or mummies at 9th).

setters.set: one clay pot filled with grave dirt, one with brackish water, and one 150 gp black onyx stone for each corpse

description.p: A thin green ray springs from your finger. The target must make a Dexterity saving throw or take 10d6 + 40 force damage. A creature reduced to 0 hit points is disintegrated into fine gray dust. The ray automatically disintegrates a Large or smaller nonmagical object or force creation. Damage increases by 3d6 per slot level above 6th.

setters.set: a lodestone and a pinch of dust

description.p: For the duration, your eyes become an inky void imbued with dread power. On your turn, choose one creature within 60 feet that can see you; it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be affected by Asleep, Panicked or Sickened (your choice). You can use your action on later turns to target another creature.

This spell allows you to find the shortest, most direct physical route to a specific fixed location that you are familiar with on the same plane. For the duration, you know how far it is and in what direction it lies.

setters.set: a set of divinatory tools worth 100 gp and an object from the location you wish to find

description.p: You attempt to turn one creature that you can see into stone. It must make a Constitution saving throw or be restrained as its flesh hardens. It repeats the save each turn; three failures petrify it, three successes end the spell. If you maintain concentration for the full duration, the petrification is permanent until removed.

setters.set: a pinch of lime, water and earth

description.p: You create a ward against magical travel that protects up to 40,000 square feet of floor space to a height of 30 feet. Creatures can’t teleport into the area or use portals to enter it, and creature types you choose take 5d10 radiant or necrotic damage when they enter or start their turn there.

setters.set: a sprinkling of holy water, rare incense and powdered ruby worth at least 1,000 gp

description.p: A frigid globe of cold energy streaks from your fingertips and explodes in a 60-foot-radius sphere. Each creature in it must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 10d6 cold damage on a failure or half on a success. It can freeze water, or you can hold the globe to throw later. Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 6th.

An immobile, faintly shimmering barrier springs into existence in a 10-foot radius around you. Any spell of 5th level or lower cast from outside the barrier can’t affect creatures or objects within it. The excluded level rises by one per slot level above 6th.

setters.set: a glass or crystal bead that shatters when the spell ends

description.p: You create a ward that protects up to 2,500 square feet of floor space with fog in corridors, arcane locks on doors, webs on stairs, and confusing passages, plus one additional magical effect of your choice.

setters.set: burning incense, a small measure of brimstone and oil, a knotted string, a small amount of umber hulk blood, and a small silver rod worth at least 10 gp

description.p: You unleash a virulent disease on a creature that you can see. It must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 14d6 necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. The damage can’t reduce it below 1 hit point, and on a failure its hit point maximum is reduced for 1 hour by the damage taken.

Choose a creature that you can see within range. A surge of positive energy washes through it, causing it to regain 70 hit points. This spell also ends blindness, deafness and any diseases affecting the target. Healing increases by 10 per slot level above 6th.

You bring forth a great feast for up to twelve creatures. A creature that partakes is cured of disease and poison, becomes immune to poison and being frightened, makes all Wisdom saving throws with advantage, and its hit point maximum and current hit points increase by 2d10 for 24 hours.

setters.set: a gem-encrusted bowl worth at least 1,000 gp, which the spell consumes

description.p: You touch an object weighing 10 pounds or less and inscribe your name on the sapphire. As an action, you can crush the sapphire to summon the object to your hand, regardless of distance or planar boundaries.

Choose one creature that you can see. It begins a comic dance: it must use all its movement to dance without leaving its space, has disadvantage on Dexterity saves and attack rolls, and other creatures have advantage on attack rolls against it. As an action, it can make a Wisdom save to regain control of itself.

Your body falls into a catatonic state as your soul leaves it and enters the container. From there, you can attempt to possess a humanoid within 100 feet (Charisma save to resist), taking control of its body while its soul is trapped in the container.

setters.set: a gem, crystal, reliquary or ornamental container worth at least 500 gp

description.p: You suggest a course of activity to up to twelve creatures of your choice that can hear and understand you. Each must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or pursue the course of action as best it can. Higher slots extend the duration.

setters.set: a snake’s tongue and either a bit of honeycomb or a drop of sweet oil

description.p: Choose an area of terrain no larger than 40 feet on a side. You can reshape dirt, sand or clay in the area in any manner you choose for the duration, changing its elevation, creating or filling trenches, and so on. Changes take 10 minutes to complete.

setters.set: an iron blade and a small bag containing a mixture of soils

description.p: You beseech an otherworldly entity for aid, and it sends a celestial, elemental or fiend loyal to it. You can ask it to perform a service in exchange for payment, depending on the difficulty of the task.

You create an illusion of an object, creature or other visible phenomenon within a 30-foot cube that activates when a specific condition occurs. When the condition occurs, the illusion springs into being and performs in the manner you described for up to 5 minutes.

setters.set: a bit of fleece and jade dust worth at least 25 gp

description.p: A beam of brilliant light flashes out from your hand in a 5-foot-wide, 60-foot line. Each creature in the line must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 6d8 radiant damage and being blinded until your next turn on a failure, or half damage on a success. You can create a new line as an action on later turns.

This spell creates a magical link between a Large or larger inanimate plant within range and another plant, at any distance, on the same plane. Any creature can step into the target plant and exit from the destination plant by using 5 feet of movement.

This spell gives the willing creature you touch truesight to a range of 120 feet: it notices secret doors hidden by magic, sees invisible creatures and objects, sees through illusions, sees the true form of shapechangers, and can see into the Ethereal Plane.

setters.set: an ointment for the eyes that costs 25 gp, which the spell consumes

description.p: You create a wall of ice made of ten 10-foot panels or a dome up to 10 feet in radius. When it appears, each creature in its area makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 10d6 cold damage on a failure or half on a success. Each panel has AC 12 and 30 hit points; breaking it leaves a sheet of frigid air that deals 5d6 cold damage.

You create a wall of tough, pliable, tangled brush bristling with needle-sharp thorns, up to 60 feet long, 10 feet high and 5 feet thick. When it appears, each creature in its area makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 7d8 piercing damage on a failure or half on a success. Moving through it deals 7d8 slashing damage per 5 feet.

You and up to ten willing creatures you can see assume a gaseous form, appearing as wisps of cloud. While in this form, a creature has a flying speed of 300 feet and resistance to nonmagical damage. It takes 1 minute to transform back.

You and up to five willing creatures within 5 feet of you instantly teleport to a previously designated sanctuary. You must first designate the sanctuary by casting this spell within a location dedicated to your deity.

You create a sword-shaped plane of force that hovers within range. When it appears, you make a melee spell attack against a target within 5 feet of it, dealing 3d10 force damage on a hit. As a bonus action on later turns, you can move it up to 20 feet and attack again.

setters.set: a miniature platinum sword with a grip and pommel of copper and zinc, worth 250 gp

description.p: A beam of yellow light flashes to a point and condenses into a glowing bead. When the spell ends, the bead explodes in a 20-foot-radius sphere: each creature makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 12d6 fire damage (plus 1d6 for each turn the bead waited) on a failure or half on a success. Damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 7th.

setters.set: a tiny ball of bat guano and sulfur

description.p: You utter a divine word imbued with the power that shaped the world. Each creature of your choice that can hear you must make a Charisma saving throw; on a failure it suffers an effect based on its current hit points (deafened, blinded, stunned or killed), and celestials, elementals, fey and fiends are forced back to their home planes.

You step into the border regions of the Ethereal Plane, where it overlaps with your current plane. You can move in any direction there and see and hear the original plane in shades of gray within 60 feet, but you can only affect and be affected by other creatures on the Ethereal Plane. Higher slots allow you to bring up to three willing creatures per level above 7th.

You send negative energy coursing through a creature that you can see. It must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 7d8 + 30 necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. A humanoid killed by this spell rises at the start of your next turn as a zombie permanently under your command.

A storm made up of sheets of roaring flame appears in up to ten 10-foot cubes you arrange. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 7d10 fire damage on a failure or half on a success. You can choose for plant life in the area to be unaffected.

An immobile, invisible, cube-shaped prison composed of magical force springs into existence: either a cage of bars (20 feet on a side) or a solid box (10 feet on a side). A creature inside can’t leave by nonmagical means, and teleporting out requires a Charisma saving throw.

setters.set: ruby dust worth 1,500 gp, which the spell consumes
