description.p: You conjure an extradimensional dwelling with a shimmering entrance. Inside is a magnificent foyer with numerous chambers, enough food for a nine-course banquet for up to 100 people, and a staff of near-transparent servants.

setters.set: a miniature portal carved from ivory, a small piece of polished marble and a tiny silver spoon, each worth at least 5 gp

description.p: You make terrain in an area up to 1 mile square look, sound, smell and even feel like some other sort of terrain. The illusion can change structures and add tactile elements, so it can cause difficult terrain or allow creatures to cross illusory bridges.

You and up to eight willing creatures who link hands in a circle are transported to a different plane of existence. Alternatively, you can make a melee spell attack to banish an unwilling creature to a plane of your choice (Charisma save).

setters.set: a forked, metal rod worth at least 250 gp, attuned to a particular plane of existence

description.p: Eight multicolored rays of light flash from your hand in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in the cone makes a Dexterity saving throw and is struck by a random ray (d8): fire, acid, lightning, poison or cold (10d6, half on a success), restraining and petrifying indigo, blinding and plane-shifting violet, or two rays.

You create an illusory copy of yourself that lasts for the duration. It can appear at any location within range that you have seen before. You can see through its eyes and hear through its ears as if you were in its space, and act through it.

setters.set: a small replica of you made from materials worth at least 5 gp

description.p: You touch a creature and stimulate its natural healing ability. The target regains 4d8 + 15 hit points, and for the duration it regains 1 hit point at the start of each of its turns. Severed body parts regrow after 2 minutes.

setters.set: a prayer wheel and holy water

description.p: You touch a dead creature that has been dead for no more than a century, that didn’t die of old age and that isn’t undead. If its soul is free and willing, it returns to life with all its hit points, with poisons and nonmagical diseases neutralized and missing body parts restored.

setters.set: a diamond worth at least 1,000 gp, which the spell consumes

description.p: This spell reverses gravity in a 50-foot-radius, 100-foot-high cylinder. All creatures and objects that aren’t anchored fall upward to the top of the area. A creature can make a Dexterity saving throw to grab onto a fixed object it can reach.

By means of this spell, a willing creature or an object can be hidden away, safe from detection. It becomes invisible and can’t be targeted by divination spells; a creature falls into suspended animation. You can set a condition that ends the spell.

setters.set: a powder composed of diamond, emerald, ruby and sapphire dust worth at least 5,000 gp, which the spell consumes

description.p: You shape an illusory duplicate of one beast or humanoid that is within range for the entire casting. The duplicate is a creature with half the original’s hit point maximum, friendly to you, that obeys your commands. It can’t regain spell slots or gain levels.

setters.set: snow or ice in quantities sufficient to make a life-size copy of the duplicated creature, some hair, fingernail clippings or other piece of that creature, and powdered ruby worth 1,500 gp

description.p: You inscribe a harmful glyph on a surface or object. When triggered, it affects creatures within 60 feet with one effect you chose: death (10d10 necrotic), discord, fear, hopelessness, insanity, pain, sleep or stunning, with a saving throw to resist.

setters.set: mercury, phosphorus and powdered diamond and opal worth at least 1,000 gp, which the spell consumes

description.p: This spell instantly transports you and up to eight willing creatures of your choice, or a single object, to a destination you select on the same plane. Your familiarity with the destination determines whether you arrive successfully, off target, in a similar area or suffer a mishap.

Your magic turns others into beasts. Choose any number of willing creatures that you can see within range; you transform each into a Large or smaller beast with a challenge rating of 4 or lower. You can use your action to transform affected creatures into new forms.

A 10-foot-radius invisible sphere of antimagic surrounds you. Within it, spells can’t be cast, summoned creatures temporarily vanish, magic items become mundane, and spell effects are suppressed. The sphere moves with you.

setters.set: a pinch of powdered iron or iron filings

description.p: This spell attracts or repels creatures of a kind you choose (such as red dragons or goblins) to a target creature or object. Antipathy makes them frightened and urged to leave; sympathy compels them to approach and remain. A Wisdom save resists the effect.

setters.set: either a lump of alum soaked in vinegar for antipathy or a drop of honey for sympathy

description.p: This spell grows an inert duplicate of a living creature as a safeguard against death. The clone matures in 120 days; if the original creature dies afterward, its soul transfers to the clone if it is free and willing.

setters.set: a diamond worth at least 1,000 gp and at least 1 cubic inch of flesh of the creature, which the spell consumes, and a vessel worth at least 2,000 gp

description.p: You take control of the weather within 5 miles of you for the duration. You must be outdoors to cast this spell. You can change precipitation, temperature and wind by one stage at a time; changes take 1d4 × 10 minutes to take effect.

setters.set: burning incense and bits of earth and wood mixed in water

description.p: You create a shadowy door on a flat solid surface that leads to a demiplane: an empty room 30 feet in each dimension, made of wood or stone. When the spell ends, the door disappears and any creatures or objects inside remain trapped. You can connect to a demiplane you created before.

You attempt to beguile a creature that you can see. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (with advantage if you are fighting it) or be charmed. You have a telepathic link and can issue commands or take total control of it. It repeats the save each time it takes damage. A 9th-level slot extends the duration to 8 hours.

You create a seismic disturbance in a 100-foot-radius circle. The ground becomes difficult terrain, concentrating creatures must save or lose concentration, creatures may be knocked prone, fissures open, and structures take damage and may collapse.

setters.set: a pinch of dirt, a piece of rock and a lump of clay

description.p: You blast the mind of a creature that you can see, attempting to shatter its intellect and personality. It takes 4d6 psychic damage and must make an Intelligence saving throw; on a failure its Intelligence and Charisma scores become 1, and it can’t cast spells or understand language. It repeats the save every 30 days.

setters.set: a handful of clay, crystal, glass or mineral spheres

description.p: Until the spell ends, when you make a Charisma check, you can replace the number you roll with a 15. Additionally, no matter what you say, magic that would determine if you are telling the truth indicates that you are being truthful.

Divine light washes out from you in a 30-foot radius. Creatures of your choice in it shed dim light, have advantage on all saving throws, and other creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls against them. A fiend or undead that hits an affected creature with a melee attack must make a Constitution save or be blinded.

setters.set: a tiny reliquary worth at least 1,000 gp containing a sacred relic

description.p: A swirling cloud of smoke shot through with white-hot embers appears in a 20-foot-radius sphere, heavily obscuring it. When it appears and when a creature enters it or starts its turn there, it makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 10d8 fire damage on a failure or half on a success. The cloud moves 10 feet away from you each turn.

You banish a creature that you can see into a labyrinthine demiplane. The target remains there for the duration or until it escapes; it can use its action to attempt a DC 20 Intelligence check to escape. Minotaurs and goristro demons automatically succeed.

Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is immune to psychic damage, any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, divination spells and the charmed condition. The spell even foils wish spells and similar effects used to affect the target’s mind or gain information about it.

You speak a word of power that can overwhelm the mind of one creature you can see. If the target has 150 hit points or fewer, it is stunned. Otherwise, the spell has no effect. The stunned target makes a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns to end the effect.

Brilliant sunlight flashes in a 60-foot radius centered on a point you choose. Each creature in the light must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 12d6 radiant damage and being blinded for 1 minute on a failure, or half damage and no blindness on a success. Undead and oozes have disadvantage. The spell dispels magical darkness of 8th level or lower.

setters.set: fire and a piece of sunstone

description.p: You and up to eight willing creatures project your astral bodies into the Astral Plane, leaving your physical bodies in suspended animation. Each astral body is connected to its physical body by a silvery cord; if the cord is cut, the creature dies.

setters.set: for each creature you affect, one jacinth worth at least 1,000 gp and one ornately carved bar of silver worth at least 100 gp, all of which the spell consumes

description.p: You touch a willing creature and bestow a limited ability to see into the immediate future. For the duration, the target can’t be surprised and has advantage on attack rolls, ability checks and saving throws. Other creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls against the target.

You conjure a portal linking an unoccupied space you can see to a precise location on a different plane of existence. When you cast the spell, you can speak the name of a specific creature to pull it through the portal to you.

setters.set: a diamond worth at least 5,000 gp

description.p: You create a magical restraint to hold a creature that you can see. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be bound by the spell: burial, chaining, hedged prison, minimus containment or slumber. You can specify a trigger that ends it.

setters.set: a vellum depiction or carved statuette in the likeness of the target, and a special component that varies according to the version of the spell you choose, worth at least 500 gp per Hit Die of the target

description.p: A flood of healing energy flows from you into injured creatures around you. You restore up to 700 hit points, divided as you choose among any number of creatures that you can see within range. Creatures healed by this spell are also cured of all diseases and any effect making them blinded or deafened.

Blazing orbs of fire plummet to the ground at four different points you can see. Each creature in a 40-foot-radius sphere centered on each point must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 20d6 fire damage and 20d6 bludgeoning damage on a failure, or half on a success. A creature in more than one area is affected only once.
You utter a word of power that can compel one creature you can see within range to die instantly. If the creature you choose has 100 hit points or fewer, it dies. Otherwise, the spell has no effect.

A shimmering, multicolored plane of light forms a vertical opaque wall or a globe. Creatures within 20 feet are blinded when they see it. Its seven layers each have a different effect on creatures passing through (damage, restraint, blindness or banishment) and must be destroyed in order.

You assume the form of a different creature for the duration. The new form can be of any creature with a challenge rating equal to your level or lower. You retain your Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma, class features and spellcasting, and can use your action to change into another form.

setters.set: a jade circlet worth at least 1,500 gp, which you must place on your head before you cast the spell

description.p: A churning storm cloud forms, centered on a point you can see and spreading to a radius of 360 feet. Lightning flashes and thunder deafens creatures beneath it; over following rounds it unleashes acid rain, lightning bolts, hail and freezing wind and rain.

You briefly stop the flow of time for everyone but yourself. No time passes for other creatures, while you take 1d4 + 1 turns in a row, during which you can use actions and move as normal. The spell ends if one of your actions affects another creature or an object worn or carried by someone else.

Choose one creature or nonmagical object that you can see. You transform the creature into a different creature, the creature into an object, or the object into a creature (Wisdom save if unwilling). If you concentrate for the full duration, the transformation lasts until dispelled.

setters.set: a drop of mercury, a dollop of gum arabic and a wisp of smoke

description.p: You touch a creature that has been dead for no longer than 200 years and that died for any reason except old age. If its soul is free and willing, it is restored to life with all its hit points and any wounds, diseases, curses or missing parts healed. You can even provide a new body.

setters.set: a sprinkle of holy water and diamonds worth at least 25,000 gp, which the spell consumes

description.p: Drawing on the deepest fears of a group of creatures, you create illusory creatures in their minds. Each creature in a 30-foot-radius sphere must make a Wisdom saving throw or become frightened. At the end of each of its turns, it must succeed on a Wisdom save or take 4d10 psychic damage.

Wish is the mightiest spell a mortal creature can cast. The basic use is to duplicate any other spell of 8th level or lower without needing its components. You can also create effects beyond that, such as creating objects, healing allies, granting resistance or undoing a recent event, at the risk of being unable to cast wish ever again.
